outName: Lesson 2-4 Overview of Complex Numbers presentation
objectives: Demonstrate the role of the imaginary unit i in the system of complex numbers.
Evaluate expressions involving the imaginary unit i and complex numbers.

standards.text: Know there is a complex number i such that i2 = -1, and every complex number has the form a + bi with a and b real.

diagnose.doneWhen: All three answers are written without a calculator, and you can say what a negative discriminant tells you about real solutions.
diagnose.notes: Speaker notes with answers, routing cues (if more than 30% miss Q1, ...) and verbal misconceptions.

practice.done: Done when: both are written as a + bi with no skipped steps.

production.title: the pump motor current
production.context: Prose only, no math symbols. Saudi / Vision 2030 context where natural, labelled as model values.
tasks: Write the current I in the form a + bi.
Find the size (modulus) of the current.
Explain why you multiplied by the conjugate.

create: Write a full solution on the back.
Swap with a partner and solve theirs.
smart.exitIntro: Exit ticket: write your answer on a sticky note and place it on the door.

recap: i squared is minus one: add, multiply, use conjugates to divide, and solve any quadratic.
